note: Measured on 2026-09-12 against gameplay-export pack v9 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v9-snapshot-20260912/fox-bf). Fixed since the prior baseline (-23, position.x, one frame after P1 enters Fall off a platform edge): game::collision::resolve's ordinary ground-lost-to-Fall branch was missing ftCo_Fall_Enter's own unconditional ftCommon_ClampAirDrift call (ftCo_Fall.c:63, ftcommon.c:457-459), so a fighter running/dashing off an edge carried its full ground speed into the first airborne frame's velocity.x instead of the clamped ca->air_drift_max value; begin_pass_as (the explicit platform-drop path) already inlined this same clamp, but the generic edge-loss path (ft_80084104/ft_800827A0, ft_081B.c:1044-1050) did not. game::collision::resolve now applies the same clamp immediately after simulation::enter(f, Action::Fall) in that branch. Confirmed against fox-bf.slp: P1's own frame-to-frame position delta drops from 2.172501 units (Run ground speed) to 0.81 units (air_drift_max scaled by stick tilt) exactly at the Fall-entry transition, matching the recording. 109 frames now match (-123 through -14); the new first divergence is frame -14, field action_age on P4 (expected 1.0, actual 0.0), a separate, undiagnosed root cause not pursued in this batch.
